tools.name: status
tools.title: Status
tools.description: Car connectivity + live state (ip, distance, ir, moving, blocked, edge).

tools.name: get_sensors
tools.title: Read sensors
tools.description: Current ultrasonic distance and IR edge-sensor values.

tools.name: stop
tools.title: Stop
tools.description: Emergency stop — halt all motion immediately.

tools.name: horn
tools.title: Horn
tools.description: Sound the buzzer (e.g. when a person is in the way).

tools.name: drive
tools.title: Drive
tools.description: Move in a direction. Forward motion gets firmware obstacle avoidance + edge protection when avoid=true (default).

duration_ms.description: Move this long then stop; omit for open-ended (deadman stops it).

avoid.description: Obstacle/edge avoidance for forward motion (default true).

tools.name: turn
tools.title: Turn
tools.description: Rotate in place by degrees (open-loop, approximate).

tools.name: scan_surroundings
tools.title: Scan
tools.description: Sweep the ultrasonic pan head and return distance at each angle.

tools.name: find_path
tools.title: Find a path
tools.description: Scan the surroundings and recommend the clearest direction to head, with the exact turn to face it. Read-only.

tools.name: map_room
tools.title: Map the room
tools.description: Rotate in place and ultrasonic-sweep to build a coarse 360° distance map, flagging open directions. Approximate.

tools.name: go_to_room
tools.title: Go to a room
tools.description: Best-effort navigation toward and through the largest opening (doorway). Time-boxed. No metric/named-room navigation.

tools.name: explore
tools.title: Explore
tools.description: Roam autonomously for a while using firmware obstacle/edge avoidance. Time-boxed.

tools.name: follow_nearest
tools.title: Follow the nearest thing
tools.description: Track the NEAREST object by ultrasonic: center it, hold a target distance. Runs a few correction cycles then returns.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.title: Navigate to a pose
tools.description: Drive to a map-frame (x, y, yaw) goal via Nav2's NavigateToPose action. Requires the navigation stack (ros2-nav/launch/navigation.launch.py) already running with a previously-saved map -- this tool does not start it.

x.description: Target x position, meters, map frame.

y.description: Target y position, meters, map frame.

timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait for the goal to finish (default 90000).

tools.name: explore_frontier
tools.title: Autonomously explore
tools.description: Launch explore_lite for a bounded time to autonomously map unexplored space, then stop it. Requires the navigation/mapping stack already running.

max_seconds.description: How long to explore before stopping (default 60).

tools.name: follow_start
tools.title: Start following
tools.description: Begin following the enrolled person using the Pi's camera. Fails if no face is enrolled yet.

tools.name: follow_stop
tools.title: Stop following
tools.description: Stop the active follow-me session and halt the robot.

tools.name: enroll_face
tools.title: Enroll face
tools.description: Capture the person currently in view and set them as the identity to follow. Call while alone in frame.

tools.name: battery_status
tools.title: Battery status
tools.description: Read the Pi's UPS HAT battery voltage and an approximate charge percentage. `low_battery` is true below 20%.

tools.name: send_to_picoclaw_agent
tools.title: Send message to PicoClaw agent
tools.description: Send a message to the PicoClaw AI agent running on this Pi and wait for a response. Use this to ask PicoClaw to control the robot, answer questions, or perform tasks. PicoClaw has access to all the robot control tools via its own MCP server.

message.description: The message to send to PicoClaw agent

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for response (default 60 seconds)

tools.name: check_picoclaw_agent_connection
tools.title: Check PicoClaw agent connection
tools.description: Check if the MQTT connection to PicoClaw agent is active.
